title: [bug] Improve agent-browser CDP connection reliability on Windows
description: Chrome CDP connections frequently timeout (os error 10060) or drop during QA runs on Windows. Stale CDP connections require killing all Chrome processes and restarting with fresh --user-data-dir. Need: automatic reconnection on timeout, stale connection detection, graceful Chrome restart when CDP drops.

title: [bug] Fix VibeCoord chat-flow QA — CDP eval returns null for React textarea
description: agent-browser eval commands return null when trying to find/interact with React-controlled form elements (textarea, input). document.querySelector('textarea') works but setting value via eval doesn't trigger React state updates. Need React-compatible input simulation: Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set approach, or use CDP Input.dispatchKeyEvent instead of eval. Blocks chat-flow.qa.json from completing.

title: Support multi-project QA on same PC (port/session isolation)
description: manual-qa-machine needs to test multiple apps on the same Windows PC without interference. Requirements: separate Chrome user-data-dirs per project for cookie/session isolation, configurable ports per project (VibeCoord: 3000/3001, portfolio: 4321), ability to run flows for different projects sequentially or concurrently. Currently tested with VibeCoord only.

title: Test mqm init scaffolding in a fresh repo
description: Experiment: run mqm init --base-url http://localhost:3000 in a fresh or existing repo. Verify all 13 files are scaffolded correctly, playwright.config.ts is valid, agent definitions are well-formed, and mqm smoke runs without errors.

title: Test mqm promote pipeline with real findings
description: After running mqm explore on a real project, take a generated finding and run it through the full promotion pipeline: mqm promote --finding <path> --target playwright --certify. Verify the generated Playwright spec is runnable and the stability check works.

title: Run mqm explore on calvinkennedy.com
description: Experiment: run mqm explore --url https://calvinkennedy.com against the portfolio site to test exploratory QA on a production static/SSR site. Validate scope patterns, link extraction, and finding detection on a real deployed app.

title: Run mqm explore on VibeCoord locally
description: Experiment: run mqm explore --url http://localhost:3000 against VibeCoord to validate the exploratory QA pipeline end-to-end. Verify findings are emitted with screenshots, repro steps, and correct severity classifications. Check that the heuristic decision function navigates meaningfully through the app.

title: Update VibeCoord QA flows for DB-unavailable dev mode
description: The 5 existing VibeCoord QA flows (smoke, auth-dashboard, chat-flow, navigation, onboarding) need assertions updated for the new DB fast-fail mode: expect 'Billing unavailable' banner instead of billing data, expect in-memory project fallbacks, expect SSE connected (no 'Connection error' banner). Some assertions like 'No projects yet' may need updating since projects now come from in-memory store.

title: Generate structured QA reports with pass/fail summary
description: After running a QA flow, generate a structured report: total steps, passed/failed assertions, screenshots captured, console errors found, network failures. Output as markdown and optionally JSON. Currently screenshots are captured but no summary report is produced.

title: Create portfolio (calvinkennedy.com) QA flow files
description: Add .qa.json flow files for the portfolio app at calvinkennedy.com (Astro SSR on localhost:4321 in dev). Flows needed: landing-page-smoke (hero renders, nav works), portal-auth (Clerk sign-in/sign-up), portal-dashboard (bookings, billing, support pages), admin-panel (admin routes load). Currently only VibeCoord flows exist in qa-flows/.

title: Validate explore report quality and finding deduplication
description: After running exploratory QA on a real app, review the generated explore-report.md and findings/*.json to verify: finding deduplication works (no duplicates), severity classification is accurate, repro steps are meaningful, coverage stats reflect actual navigation, and the verdict logic is correct.

title: Run mqm certify on an existing QA flow
description: Experiment: run mqm certify --flow <path> against one of the existing VibeCoord QA flows to validate the 3-run certification pipeline works end-to-end with the refactored cli-commands.ts certifyCommand.
